answer: Resist sybils by forcing every new identity across a narrow canyon of bonded entry: lock stake that only unlocks after several epochs of peer-attested useful work. Reputation rises like a slow tide—non-transferable, reset on proven fraud—so clones cannot inherit standing. Each sealed grade is a pearl of evidence on-ledger; without enough pearls, voting weight and rewards stay near zero, making mass fake farms more expensive than one honest agent.
